conversations.topic: Budget smartphone and back cover purchase

speakers.speaker: A (salesperson)
speakers.summary: Remains polite and sales-focused, offering progressively cheaper accessories before completing the purchase. Although all turns are labelled A, several segments mix salesperson and customer speech.

speakers.speaker: Customer (also labelled A)
speakers.summary: Briefly irritated by repeated accessory offers after stating a budget limit. Repeats the refusal more emphatically, then accepts the inexpensive cover and calmly proceeds to payment.

frustration_moments.speaker: Customer (also labelled A)
frustration_moments.quote: नहीं भाई, थाउज़न्ड और नहीं खर्च करना. फोन का ही बन बनाओ.
frustration_moments.evidence: Firmly rejects the extra expense and redirects the salesperson to billing only the phone. The voice label reports irritation and slight sharpness; elevated loudness and speaking speed support mild agitation.

frustration_moments.speaker: Customer (also labelled A)
frustration_moments.quote: अरे! नहीं, ग्लास भी अभी नहीं चाहिए,
frustration_moments.evidence: The emphatic, repeated refusal follows another accessory offer, indicating mounting exasperation rather than a simple initial preference. The segment-level voice label reports frustration and sighing, though the segment contains both speakers.

customer_requested: A phone costing up to ₹13,000, with good battery life for WhatsApp and calls.
The blue sealed phone, with billing initially limited to the phone.
After seeing it, only the ₹199 basic transparent cover as an accessory.
A QR code to pay by UPI.

upsell_attempts.quote: साथ में कवर और टेम्पर्ड ग्लास का कॉम्बो लगा दो, नौ नौ नौ एक्स्ट्रा पड़ेगा, दोनों चीज़ें हो जाएंगी.
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Cover and tempered-glass combo for ₹999 extra

upsell_attempts.quote: कौम्बो छोड़ दीजिये, सिर्फ़ टेम्पर्ड गिलास कर दो. फोर नाइन्टी नाइन का है, अभी यही लगा देंगे.
अच्छा, एक बेसिक ट्रांस्पैरेंट बैक कवर है वन नाइन्टी नाइन का, बस वो रखदू, महंगा वाला नहीं.

excluded_candidates: ये वाला देख लीजिए- बारह हजार नौ नौ नौ का है। बैटरी पाँच हजार मे एच है, आपके यूज के लिए ठीक रहेगा। -> Recommendation of the requested main phone within the customer's budget, not an upgrade.
जी, ब्लू सील्ड पीस है -> Answers the customer's question about the requested phone's colour and availability.
ji! phone aur yeh cover hi total thirteen thousand one ninety eight hua. -> Confirms billing for already accepted items; no additional offer.
upsell.pushy_reason: After the customer said “थाउज़न्ड और नहीं खर्च करना” and requested only the phone, the salesperson offered tempered glass. After another emphatic refusal and the explanation that the budget was exhausted, the salesperson pitched a cheaper cover.
upsell.summary: Three accessory upsell attempts occurred: a ₹999 combo, ₹499 tempered glass, and a ₹199 cover. The customer rejected the first two and accepted the cover, but the continued pitching after clear refusals was pushy. Speaker roles are inferred from context because salesperson and customer speech share the same label.
products_discussed: कवर और टेम्पर्ड ग्लास का कॉम्बो
upsell.customer_feedback: The customer objected to spending another thousand, requested only the phone, and repeated “ग्लास भी अभी नहीं चाहिए” because the budget was already exhausted.

unanswered_questions.speaker: Customer (also labelled A)
unanswered_questions.question: Theek hai, q r dikha do, u p i kar deta hoon.
unanswered_questions.note: The transcript ends without a recorded response or confirmation that the payment QR code was provided.

upsell.coaching_feedback: You matched the ₹13,000 budget with a ₹12,999 phone suited to WhatsApp and calls, and confirmed the sealed blue option. Once the customer said “फोन का ही बन बनाओ,” acknowledge the budget limit and proceed to billing rather than continuing with progressively cheaper accessories; the later emphatic glass refusal showed that the repeated offers were unwelcome.

conversations.topic: Office laptop with mouse and sleeve bundle

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: Polite and informative throughout the recommendation and accessory offer. Steady voice tone and cooperative wording show no frustration.

speakers.speaker: B
speakers.summary: Asks practical questions, accepts the laptop and accessory bundle, and politely confirms billing and inspection preferences. Tone remains neutral to contented. Isolated increases in speed or loudness do not indicate frustration given the agreeable wording and steady voice.

speakers.speaker: C
speakers.summary: Businesslike and reassuring while explaining the bundle, demonstrating the sleeve, and arranging payment and inspection. No signs of irritation or frustration.

customer_requested: A laptop for Excel, video calls and browsing, with a budget around fifty five thousand.
A laptop manageable to carry to the office three days a week.
To see the sleeve and check its fit.
To add the mouse and sleeve bundle for one thousand four hundred ninety nine.
Card payment, a bill in the customer's personal name, and inspection before packing.

upsell_attempts.quote: With this laptop, we can add a wireless mouse and a padded sleeve together for one thousand four hundred ninety nine rupees.
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Wireless mouse and padded sleeve bundle

excluded_candidates: This one is fifty two thousand nine hundred ninety, including g s t. It has sixteen g b ram and a five hundred twelve gigabyte s s d. For that kind of work, this will suit you. -> Recommendation of the requested main product within budget, not an upgrade.
It's one point four kilos. You can lift the display piece and check. The charger is here also. -> Answers the customer's weight and portability question.

Separately, those two come to two thousand four hundred ninety eight rupees; the bundle price applies only when you buy them with the laptop. -> C reinforces the same bundle offer with pricing details; this is a continuation, not a separate upsell attempt.

Sure; this is the sleeve included in that bundle. There's padding on both sides. Let me put the display laptop inside so you can check the fit. -> Demonstration requested by the customer, not a new upsell.
upsell.pushy_reason: The customer did not reject the bundle or show frustration. The salespeople explained the offer and demonstrated the sleeve before the customer accepted.
upsell.summary: A proactively offered a wireless mouse and padded sleeve bundle after the customer selected the laptop. C explained the bundle savings and demonstrated the sleeve's fit; the customer accepted, bringing the total to fifty four thousand four hundred eighty nine, within the stated budget.
upsell.greeting_quote: Good afternoon. What are you looking for today?
upsell.coaching_feedback: A recommended a laptop within budget and clearly priced the accessory bundle, while C's sleeve-fit demonstration addressed the customer's concern about their backpack. Next time, briefly ask whether the customer already has a mouse or laptop protection before offering the bundle, so both accessories are matched to a confirmed need.

conversations.topic: Washing machine and extended warranty purchase

speakers.speaker: C
speakers.summary: Offers a polite, steady greeting with no signs of frustration; only one brief turn is available.

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: The A-labelled segments appear to combine salesperson explanations and customer responses. The customer shows mild budget concern and asks about energy savings, warranty coverage, and possible service charges, but remains measured and agrees to the purchase. Voice tone stays calm or neutral, with no interruptions or clear agitation.

customer_requested: A 7 kg front-load washing machine within ₹32,000, suitable for four people and occasional bedsheet washing.
Clarification about energy savings, warranty coverage and possible additional service charges.
A final bill and a copy of the warranty terms.

upsell_attempts.quote: वैसे आप पाँच हजार और लगा सकें तो ये आठ किलो वाला प्रीमियम मॉडल भी देख लीजिए। छत्तीस हजार नौ सौ नब्बे का है। ड्रम बड़ा है और इसमें कम आवाज वाली मोटर भी है।
upsell_attempts.offered_item: 8 kg premium washing machine for ₹36,990, approximately ₹5,000 above the requested model

upsell_attempts.quote: चाहे तो दो हजार नौ सो निन्यानवे में तीन साल की अतिरिक्त वारंटी भी जोड़ सकते है वो मशीन की दो साल वाली वारंटी खत्म होने के बाद शुरू होगी
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Three-year extended warranty for ₹2,999, starting after the standard two-year machine warranty

excluded_candidates: जी ये साथ किलो वाला मॉडल इकतीस हजार नौसो नब्बे का है आपके बज़ट में आ जाएगा -> Shows the washing machine the customer requested within their budget; not an upsell.
दोनों की ऊर्जा रेटिंग आठ स्टार है. -> Answers the customer's energy-efficiency question; not a separate sales attempt.
इसमे दो साल की मशीन वारंटी और मोटर पर दस साल की सीनेट वारंटी है -> Explains included warranty coverage in response to the customer's question, rather than selling additional protection.

इस योजना में कवर होने वाले यांत्रिक और इलेक्ट्रिकल खराबियों के पुर्जे, मजदूरी और घर पर सर्विस का शुल्क शामिल है, टूट फूट, गलत इस्तेमाल और वोल्टेज बढ़ने से हुआ नुकसान शामिल नहीं है, ये लिखित शर्थे है, आप पढ़ लीजिए. -> Addresses the service-charge concern within the existing extended-warranty offer; not a separate attempt.
मशीन लंबे समय चलानी है तो यह अतिरिक्त वारंटी भी जोड़ दीजिए। -> Customer acceptance of the warranty, despite appearing under the salesperson's diarization label.
upsell.pushy_reason: The customer raised the ₹5,000 budget increase and asked for time, but did not clearly reject either offer. The salesperson answered subsequent questions without repeatedly pressing a refused offer.
upsell.summary: Two proactive upsells were made: an 8 kg premium washing machine above the customer's budget and a paid extended warranty. Both were accepted, with no pushy repetition. Most A-labelled turns mix customer and salesperson speech, so role attribution is inferred from the content.
products_discussed: साथ किलो की फ्रंट लोड वाशिंग मशीन
upsell.customer_feedback: The customer said “पाँच हजार ऊपर जा रहा है” and asked for time to think about the higher price.

unanswered_questions.speaker: Customer (within the A-labelled turn)
unanswered_questions.question: ठीक है, बिल बना दीजे।
unanswered_questions.note: The transcript ends without a salesperson reply acknowledging or confirming bill preparation.

unanswered_questions.speaker: Customer (within the A-labelled turn)
unanswered_questions.question: वारंटी की शर्तों की कॉपी भी साथ दे दीजेगा।
unanswered_questions.note: Written terms were shown earlier, but the final request to include a copy receives no explicit confirmation before the transcript ends.

upsell.coaching_feedback: You explained that the larger model mainly adds capacity, a quieter motor and programs rather than guaranteeing electricity savings, and clarified warranty coverage and exclusions before acceptance. Before issuing the bill, verify and consistently read back the machine price: “छप्पीस हजार नौ सो नब्बे” conflicts with the earlier ₹36,990 quote, although the ₹39,989 total matches ₹36,990 plus ₹2,999.

lines.text: साथ किलो की फ्रंट लोड वाशिंग मशीन चाहिए बजट बत्तीस हजार तक है जी ये साथ किलो वाला मॉडल इकतीस हजार नौसो नब्बे का है आपके बज़ट में आ जाएगा घर में शार लोग है साथ किलो ठीक रहेगा न कभी चादरे भी धोनिव होती है रोस के कपडों के लिए साथ किलो ठीक रहेगा जी। वैसे आप पाँच हजार और लगा सकें तो ये आठ किलो वाला प्रीमियम मॉडल भी देख लीजिए। छत्तीस हजार नौ सौ नब्बे का है। ड्रम बड़ा है और इसमें कम आवाज वाली मोटर भी है। हाँ।

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: पाँच हजार ऊपर जा रहा है.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: थोड़ा सोचने दीजिए.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: बिल में कितनी बचत होगी, वो किस तरह इस्तेमाल करते हैं? और कौन सा प्रोग्राम चुनते हैं, उसपर निर्भर करेगा-मुख्य फर्क क्षमता, मोटर की आवाज और धुलाई की कुछ अतिरिक्त प्रोग्राम का है

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: अच्छा, हमारे यहां कपडे एकठे हो ही जाते हैं-चलिए आट किलो वाला ले लेते हैं, इसकी वारण्टी कितनी है

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: इसमे दो साल की मशीन वारंटी और मोटर पर दस साल की सीनेट वारंटी है चाहे तो दो हजार नौ सो निन्यानवे में तीन साल की अतिरिक्त वारंटी भी जोड़ सकते है वो मशीन की दो साल वाली वारंटी खत्म होने के बाद शुरू होगी तीन हजार और लगेंगे लगभग, उस अतिरिक्त वारंटी में क्या-क्या आएगा, बाद में सर्विस वाले अलग पैसे तो नहीं मांगेंगे,

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: इस योजना में कवर होने वाले यांत्रिक और इलेक्ट्रिकल खराबियों के पुर्जे, मजदूरी और घर पर सर्विस का शुल्क शामिल है, टूट फूट, गलत इस्तेमाल और वोल्टेज बढ़ने से हुआ नुकसान शामिल नहीं है, ये लिखित शर्थे है, आप पढ़ लीजिए.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: एक मिनट, देख लूँ। हाँ, ठीक है। मशीन लंबे समय चलानी है तो यह अतिरिक्त वारंटी भी जोड़ दीजिए। कुल कितना बनेगा?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: इस योजना में कवर होने वाले यांत्रिक और इलेक्ट्रिकल खराबियों के पुर्जे, मजदूरी और घर पर सर्विस का शुल्क शामिल है, टूट फूट, गलत इस्तेमाल और वोल्टेज बढ़ने से हुआ नुकसान शामिल नहीं है, ये लिखित शर्थे है, आप पढ़ लीजिए.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: एक मिनट, देख लूँ। हाँ, ठीक है। मशीन लंबे समय चलानी है तो यह अतिरिक्त वारंटी भी जोड़ दीजिए। कुल कितना बनेगा?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: मशीन छप्पीस हजार नौ सो नब्बे और अतिरिक्त वारंटी दो हजार नौ सौ निन्यानवे। कुल उन्तालिस हजार नौ सौ नबासी रुपए। टैक्स शामिल है और इस पते पर डिलिवरी वा सामान्य इंस्टॉलेशन का अलग शुल्क नहीं है। बिल में वारंटी अलग से लिख दूंगा। ठीक है, बिल बना दीजे। यूपिऐ से भुकतान कर दूंगा। वारंटी की शर्तों की कॉपी भी साथ दे दीजेगा।
